messages:
sam: FYI — noticed p95/p99 tails disappeared on the global latency dashboard after the edge-proxy update last night. Support ticket INC-4827 just flagged it. Anyone seeing this? :eyes:

maria: on it. which dashboard exactly? global or region-specific?

sam: global > latency > request-latency (all models). Graf shows median/avg but no p95/p99 lines. Last good datapoint ~2026-03-16 22:15 UTC.

maria: checked the metrics exporter logs — endpoint restarted ~22:16 and the metric types looked different. wondering if labels/names changed during the proxy update.

alex: deploy-bot shows edge-proxy v2.4.9 rolled 22:14->22:17. Release notes mentioned "metrics: standardize histogram buckets" — could be related.

priya: FYI support-bot: customer says tails look much lower but they're probably just not plotted. CS escalated.

maria: quick repro: `curl http://metrics-internal:9100/metrics | grep request_latency` — I see histogram buckets but no summary/quantile lines.

sam: can you paste the snippet?

maria: ```
# HELP request_latency_seconds histogram of request latency
# TYPE request_latency_seconds histogram
request_latency_seconds_bucket{le=\"0.1\",...} 123
...
# no request_latency_seconds{quantile=\"0.95\"} lines present
```

alex: Grafana panels expect client-side quantiles from summaries. If we switched exporters to histograms only, panels won't render p95/p99. Options: emit summaries too or change panels to calculate quantiles from histograms.

priya: Is rollback an option? This touched metrics proto, so might be annoying. Who's oncall to approve rollback?

maria: @alex @sam i'll prep a quick patch to emit summary-style quantiles alongside histograms in the proxy. Pushing to canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: edge-proxy v2.4.10-canary at 23:05 UTC

alex: note increased metric cardinality risk, but canary shows quantile series back in dashboards for canary region.

sam: great — told CS we can give approximate tail numbers until fix is in prod.

maria: patch merged to canary, health looks good. rolling to prod in 10m unless objections.

priya: CS thumbs-up but please add a release note and an alert rule to catch missing quantile series in future.

sam: suggestion for alert: `count_over_time(request_latency{quantile=\"0.95\"}[10m]) == 0` -> alert. Also have a histogram-based fallback expression.

alex: will add alert + fallback transform on dashboard panels so they compute p95 from histogram if quantile series absent.

support-bot: INC-4827 updated: triaged, mitigation in progress.

sam: after prod roll, check the gap 22:15-23:37 — quantiles will be present after 23:37, earlier window might need backfill from histograms.

maria: noted. i'll create a follow-up task to run a backfill if dashboards still show empty tails.

alex: rolling prod now.

deploy-bot: deploy success: edge-proxy v2.4.10 at 23:37 UTC

maria: confirming: p95/p99 lines re-appeared on global dashboard for times >= 23:37. The 22:16-23:37 window lacks quantile series because exporter didn't emit them during v2.4.9.

priya: CS updated customer with timeline and mitigation steps. they'll reopen if numbers still look off. adding postmortem to incidents once we close.

sam: adding this thread to incidents and assigning eng-runtime for follow-up and backfill. Thanks all :rocket:
